jobs.occupation: Inside sales | German market | 100% on site in Antwerp
jobs.description:

You will join a dynamic, international family-owned company in the food industry, where initiative, commercial drive and results are highly valued.

Our client is a well-established international company operating within the food sector. With a family-business mindset, entrepreneurial spirit, and strong growth ambitions, they offer a fast-paced environment where initiative and results are highly valued.

• Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills, credibility and executive presence.
• Able to build conviction and establish trust with experienced investors.
• Entrepreneurial, proactive and comfortable working within a growing business.
• Fluent Dutch, French and English is strongly preferred.
